general_information.Syllabus Name: IoT application development project_Dự án phát triển ứng dụng IoT
general_information.Learning-Teaching Method: Experiential learning methods, Project Based Training, Student-centered theory, In-class lecture, Active Learning
general_information.Time Allocation: 45h (60 sessions) contact hours + 0.75h final exam + 104.25h self-study
general_information.Description: This course is aimed to give you the basics you need to start working with IoT. Students are required to carry out projects in laboratories as assigned by teachers (mentors), through sample tutorials, students can do IoT applications in practice, training students the basic skills of practicing technical professions in the field of control through the Internet to connect things. Group size is limited to 1-2 students, appointed by the faculty (mentor)
general_information.StudentTasks: - Register for the programming language to be used C and Arduino software '- Get group allocation and assignment(s) as arranged by the teacher (mentor) '- Select team leader & create a Git environment ( use account @ fpt.edu.vn) '- Split and schedule work with other team members within repeat binding (see Appendix 1) '- Attend at least 80% of exposure slots to accept the final result '- Students are responsible for following the Regulations of the Lab '- Only use student laptops for all practice/study purposes '- Report on work status, present work results according to the provisions of Appendix 1
general_information.Tools: • Arduino IDE 1.8.10 or higher • Tinkercad • Web server application: + Blynk cloud server • Electronic devices used in the project (for a group of Students). + 01 Boad ESP8266 NodeMCU Lua CP2102 or (Module Wifi RF Bluetooth ESP32 NodeMCU) + 01 Boad Temperature and humidity sensor DHT11 + 01 Breadboard + Cable 40 male - female 10 cm + 01 Boad I2c + 01 Boad LCD 16x2 + 01 DC5V 3A Power Supply Adapter + 01 Jack DC Female 5.5x2.1 mm DC-017 + 01 Buzzer 3V + 01 Mobile phone
general_information.Note: 1) On-going Assessment: 50% Students work in a project team of 1-2 members on the assignments as appointed by the teacher The works are organized by iterations with the contents and assessments as below (each student is assign to practice full-stack codes on assigned/selected function) - PA-AD: Analyze & Design: 15% - PA-CAIDE: Coding Arduino IDE: 10% - PA-DBI: Download Blynk app and Install: 10% - PA-PCO: Practice Connection and Project Operation: 15% 2) Final Project Presentation: 50% - Project output and report writing: 25% - Mastery of assigned works: 15% - Soft Skills & Working Attitudes: 10%

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Use the knowledge learned to solve technical problems related to IoT.
Acquire data, examine the methods of infrastructure for boad Arduino and ESP8266.
Apply project management principles to IoT application development projects
Practice presentations and communication among team members.

assessments.Grading Guide: Team Evaluation (see "Assessment Details" in the "Assessment Matrix" sheet
assessments.Note: To be selected for the Final Presentation, each student needs: * On-going grade assessment: Four parts (PA-AD-KS, PA-CAIDE-SA, PA-DBI-SA, PA-PCO-SA) >=5. Refer to Assessment Matrix in detail. * No cheating during the project progress

assessments.Grading Guide: Individual & Team Evaluation (see "Assessment Details" in the "Assessment Matrix" sheet
assessments.Note: The exam is organized by Academic Organization and Management Department. Must have at least 2 teachers for grading Final Project Presentation (This part includes the report slide + report book (Template_IoT391) + project product.) Khảo thí tổ chức và phải có ít nhất 2 GV đánh giá cho mỗi nhóm vì phần này gồm Slide báo cáo + Cuốn báo cáo (Template_IoT391) + sản phẩm của dự án.
